title: Knitting & Crochet Word Search
subtitle: Large Print: 60 Easy-to-Read Puzzles for Knitters, Crocheters & Seniors
description:
Yarn lovers, this one is for you.

Take a cozy break from your needles and hooks with 60 large print word search puzzles made for fiber fans. Every puzzle celebrates the language of yarn, from cast on and cables to granny squares, amigurumi and the local yarn shop.

Inside you'll find:

  • 60 themed puzzles: stitches, fibers, tools, sweaters, sheep breeds, seasons and more
  • Large, bold letters on big 8.5 x 11 inch pages that are easy on the eyes
  • Words run forward and diagonally only, never backwards
  • One puzzle per page, with every answer at the back

A thoughtful gift for knitters, crocheters, yarn club friends, grandmothers and retirees. Perfect for birthdays, Mother's Day and Christmas stockings.
